name: Bad Iburg (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Bad Iburg (a red eagle rising from a red wheel on white).
history: The arms, designed by Heinrich Lüder-Lühr, were last approved by the Lower Saxon Minister of the Interior in 1956; the flag is divided red and white with the arms.

features.role: Bad Iburg arms — red eagle and wheel on white
